name: HYPER-U (self-stripping urea process)
description: Vendor product line read 2026-11-24. Claimed lower steam/cooling water demand and OPEX; new plants and revamps. Primary source: https://www.casale.ch/technologies/urea/

specifications.basis: Casale Urea page: 'HYPER-U is an improved self-stripping urea process which enhances efficiency by incorporating a Medium-High Pressure (MHP) carbamate decomposition step'
'Enhanced thermal efficiency; Reduced demand for medium-pressure steam and cooling water; Improved operational cost (OPEX); Smaller carbon footprint; Compatibility with new plants and revamps'

notes: Claimed lower steam/cooling water demand and OPEX; new plants and revamps. Full-parameter pass 2026-11-26: 2 new printed parameters.

gaps.what: Numeric steam/cooling-water consumption, conversion and capacity figures for HYPER-U
gaps.why: Only qualitative benefits on the HTML page; numeric data in the HYPER-U technical brochure PDF
